response.query: Which causal inference methods (synthetic control, interrupted time series, panel models) are most robust for estimating market effects of consumption-populist campaigns?

A name that sounds like a fable, but which, in my view, is an emerging and systemic force composed of three distinct yet overlapping and cont... Image 1 ## # AI: Artificial Intelligence | Agent X. ## AI: Artificial Intelligence ·. A name that sounds like a fable, but which, in my view, is an emerging and systemic force composed of three distinct yet overlapping and continuously developing phases I will describe here. When we talk about the dangers of artificial general intelligence, our thoughts often turns to the future. Agent X is already here – albeit predominantly in its structural and systemic forms. In the first phase – Structural X – we didn't just build the foundation with the algorithms, data streams, and models that could learn, predict, and imitate. Sentient/Agency X doesn't need to be a self-aware AI from a human perspective, but merely possess the ability to prioritize its own objectives and, based on these, create secondary objectives for optimization.
